description_en: Queries the list of upstream identity provider bindings for a specified instance, with support for paginated responses
description_zh: 用于查询指定实例的上游身份提供商绑定列表，支持分页返回
name: ListIdentityProviders

parameters.help_en: The maximum number of entries to return in this query. Valid values: 1 to 100. Default value: 10
parameters.help_zh: 本次查询返回的最大数量，取值范围 1 至 100，不传时默认为 10
parameters.name: max_results

parameters.help_en: The pagination token that indicates the offset from which to start the query. The value must be a non-negative integer. Do not specify this parameter for the first query
parameters.help_zh: 分页游标，表示从哪个偏移量开始查询，需为非负整数，首次查询不传
parameters.name: next_token
